title: LLMs Forget Their Intentions
description:
Are AI models dropping the ball on their own promises? Discover the hidden flaw causing massive disconnects between what language models say they will do and what they actually execute.

This episode reveals the surprising reasons behind AI's "intent-to-action" gaps and explains why even the smartest models sometimes forget their own plans—despite having all the context they need.Join Robert Ronan and Jeffrey Smith as they unpack the core problem: models’ internal contradictions between stated intentions and real-world behaviors. You'll discover how this disconnect impacts AI reliability and what developers can do to address it, ensuring smarter, more consistent language systems.
#LLM #ai
